title: 第一卷 第332章 周万金来了
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周万金来的时候，排场很大。

二十多个护院，四个账房先生，还有两个穿长衫的读书人。

一群人堵在县衙门口，把半条街都占了。

周万金本人又胖又白。

不是田大富那种官场圆润。

他是粮仓里养出来的肥。

手指戴玉扳指，腰间挂金算盘，一站在那里，就差把“我有钱”三个字刻脸上。

周绍被关在后堂，听见他爹来了，立刻又活了。

“爹！救我！”

她还没想好要不要收这个学生呢，等做决定之前，随便这丫头怎么折腾。

“好。”铁塔脸上露出了敬佩的笑容，强横的气劲随着他双手展开，呈半圆形展开，将二人包裹了其中。

大概是父亲感觉到有那么一点愧疚，又因为不想看着他整天闷闷不乐的样子，他答应了。

“什么是该吃的，什么是不该吃的，你难道不会分辨？”西陵璟捉住她的手，令她老实起来。

按冯盎预先教过的话一讲，独孤兰若根本就没想太多，更何况冯盎讨要的只是五条船，几百人的南下剿匪。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Zhou Wanjin came, there was a lot of pomp and circumstance.

There are more than twenty nursing homes, four accountants, and two scholars wearing long gowns.

A group of people blocked the gate of the county government office and occupied half of the street.

Zhou Wanjin himself is fat and white.

He is not as smooth and official as Tian Dafu.

He is fattened in the granary.

Wearing jade rings on his fingers and a gold abacus hanging on his waist, as soon as he stood there, he almost had the words "I am rich" carved on his face.

Zhou Shao was imprisoned in the back hall. When he heard his father coming, he immediately came back to life.

"Dad! Save me!"

She hasn't decided whether to accept this student yet. Before making a decision, this girl can do whatever she wants.

"Okay." A smile of admiration appeared on Tieta's face, and his tyrannical energy spread out in a semicircle as his hands spread out, wrapping the two of them.

Probably because his father felt a little guilty and didn't want to see him moping around all day, he agreed.

"Can't you tell the difference between what you should eat and what you shouldn't eat?" Xilingjing grabbed her hand and asked her to be honest.

According to what Feng Ang had taught him in advance, Dugu Lanruo didn't think too much at all, not to mention that what Feng Ang wanted was only five ships and hundreds of people to go south to suppress the bandits.
